nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.rationale: Central project guideline; emphasizes skinny controllers, fat models, Minitest fixtures, and functional design tokens.

nodes.label: Sure Design System
nodes.rationale: Enforces functional tokens (text-primary, bg-container) over raw Tailwind palette; mandates semantic HTML and DS::* components.

nodes.label: Minitest Framework
nodes.rationale: Mandates Minitest + fixtures for testing; discourages RSpec/FactoryBot; emphasizes boundary testing and minimal mocks.

nodes.label: Plaid Integration
nodes.rationale: Manages bank data syncing; supports pending transactions and FX metadata via PlaidItem and Sync models.
